roe.text: In Akoum, cultists infected by Ulamog's creative force perform rituals that loosen the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

Zhulodok awakens and razes the land, and only twelve cultists survive to become the first vampire bloodchiefs, until Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
Later, Anowon hunts for the Eye of Ugin from his camp in Akoum, and Chandra Nalaar comes asking for guidance, and he agrees once he learns she also seeks the Eye.

Nissa wins over the Moon Kraken Brinelin by telling him of Sutina's death, but nulls led by the vampires Biss and Shir ambush the group and take her prisoner, and she pushes Sorin to admit he is a vampire and the cause of the vanishings.

ori.text: When Zendikar breaks open, Nahiri senses that the Eldrazi prison has been opened, and near the Eye of Ugin she finds a spiked stone building where the hedron network was disturbed.
She kills the vampires there, discovers a bloodstained altar and a statue of Ulamog, and realizes their sacrifices disrupted the network.
Nahiri reshapes the statue into a new hedron, completing it and repairing the prison to drive the titans back into torpor.
Elsewhere, Nissa crosses the foothills of Akoum practicing her new powers, calms the Roil by humming her mother's animist song, and at the dark knot her spark ignites, hurling her from Zendikar.
